Name: Alternate Annetta Portraits for Cape Stardew
Author: RoboticSlothAtlier
Description:
First time making a mod.

Simply alters the portraits of Annetta to a more vanilla-like style.

The original mod is by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Lucidvisionsinc[/url]﻿.

Unzip and drop the file "[CP] Alternate Annetta Portraits" into the mods folder like any other content patcher mod.
